names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Алексий (Введенский), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «… и Алексия пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, although the corpus holds three folders of the surname under other forenames.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая и Алексия пресвитеров (1938).»

attestations.note: The second of the two one line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS. The line says «пресвитеров» and his name page «протоиерей», archpriest. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: `fk.mjs` on «Алексий (Введенский)» returns NONE, and the Введенский folders the corpus does keep are `vladimir-vvedensky`, `vladimir-vvedensky-21-march` and others of different forenames. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under either name.
